entries.name: Kootenay Lake boundaries
entries.regs_verbatim: Kootenay Lake Boundaries. Main Body — the area east of a line between boundary signs on opposite shores near Balfour Point and Procter Lighthouse. Upper West Arm — the area west of that line, to McDonalds Landing (Six Mile). Lower West Arm — the area between McDonalds Landing (Six Mile) and Corra Linn Dam. IMPORTANT Kootenay Lake recovery may require in-season regulation changes.

rules.verbatim: Main Body — the area east of a line between boundary signs on opposite shores near Balfour Point and Procter Lighthouse.
rules.review_reason: One of the three reaches Kootenay Lake's water entries reference by name. Until purpose-built polygons exist all its rules point at the whole lake, and this definition is what tells the reader which arm they are on.

rules.verbatim: Upper West Arm — the area west of that line, to McDonalds Landing (Six Mile).
rules.review_reason: One of the three reaches Kootenay Lake's water entries reference by name. Until purpose-built polygons exist all its rules point at the whole lake, and this definition is what tells the reader which arm they are on.

rules.verbatim: Lower West Arm — the area between McDonalds Landing (Six Mile) and Corra Linn Dam.
rules.review_reason: One of the three reaches Kootenay Lake's water entries reference by name. Until purpose-built polygons exist all its rules point at the whole lake, and this definition is what tells the reader which arm they are on.

rules.verbatim: IMPORTANT Kootenay Lake recovery may require in-season regulation changes.
rules.review_reason: The chapter warns Kootenay Lake recovery may force IN-SEASON changes. Nothing in the corpus carries a validity window or an amendment channel, so a reader cannot tell whether what they are looking at is still true.
